positive.title: Mega Ball Hype Machine
positive.description: The ZYN Mega Ball 2026 is the single largest conversation driver, generating massive positive sentiment through event coverage, celebrity sightings, and attendee excitement. It functions as the brand's anchor narrative.

positive.title: Summer Circuit Buzz
positive.description: The ZYN Summer series (Cebu, Siargao, Boracay) creates a sustained positive conversation wave from March through May, building anticipation for the Mega Ball and establishing ZYN as a lifestyle brand.

positive.title: Celebrity Endorsement Power
positive.description: Heart Evangelista, Donny Pangilinan, and other celebrity LANUs drive high-engagement positive content. Celebrity mentions carry the highest positive sentiment ratio of any topic.

positive.title: Flavor Discovery Wave
positive.description: Growing organic conversation around ZYN flavors, particularly mint and citrus, with consumers sharing genuine product experiences and recommendations. This is expanding beyond the event-driven audience.

positive.title: Smoke-Free Lifestyle Community
positive.description: A small but growing community of users positioning ZYN as part of a smoke-free lifestyle choice, using hashtags like #SmokeFree and sharing personal switch stories.

risk.title: Underage Access Concerns — "Ang daming bata"
risk.description: The most urgent risk narrative. Reports of teenagers purchasing and using ZYN, concentrated in Filipino-language social media. Spiked sharply after the Mega Ball 2026 event, suggesting large events increase visibility to minors.

risk.title: Health Risk Anxiety — "Safe ba talaga?"
risk.description: Steady-burn concern about long-term health effects of nicotine pouches. Concentrated in forums and X/Twitter. Often framed as questions rather than accusations, but the uncertainty itself is damaging.

risk.title: Price Resistance — "Ang mahal na"
risk.description: Growing complaints about ZYN pricing, particularly in the August-September period. Price sensitivity is highest outside Metro Manila. Some users explicitly mention switching to cheaper alternatives.

risk.title: Ploom Design Appeal — "Mas premium ang Ploom"
risk.description: A subset of comparison mentions favor Ploom's device design and premium positioning. While ZYN wins on flavor variety, Ploom is gaining mindshare on aesthetics and brand image.

risk.title: Regulatory Scrutiny — "Kailangan ng batas"
risk.description: Calls for government regulation of nicotine pouch sales, particularly around age verification. This narrative overlaps with the underage access concern and could attract media or legislative attention.
